description: Bootstrap a real backend (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions) with no account and no bearer token: call this before `initialize` ever sees an Authorization header. Solves its own proof-of-work, creates a temporary project (expires in about 72h unless claimed), and returns connection details, a project-scoped agent token you can use as the bearer for every tool after this one, a claim_url, and claim_before (the UTC time the project is deleted). Always show the person the `keep.hint` line (or `tell_the_person`) right away: "Keep this project before <claim_before>: <claim_url>" — the project is deleted at that time otherwise, and only a person can claim it (sign up + card, same URL and keys). If you already have a bearer token, use projects.create instead.

name.description: Project name, e.g. `todo-app` (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Optional.

name: projects.start
title: Start without an account
